title: Hardrock Runners - Rules Summary
claims: The rules prohibit muling: pacers may not carry water, food, flashlights, shoes, clothing or other supplies for their runner.
Runners must leave each aid station by the posted cut-off time.
Stashing supplies is prohibited and aid may only be accepted within 400 yards of a designated aid station.
Runners may be pulled for medical and safety reasons.
Aid Station Captains have authority to act on behalf of Hardrock run management.
Only one pacer may be on course with a runner at a time, and pacers may meet runners only at crew-access aid stations.
The course is closed; cutting switchbacks is prohibited and a runner who deviates must backtrack to the point of departure.
All runners must complete a service requirement before the start.
All runners must carry a run-provided GPS tracking device.
Runners are responsible for the actions of their crews and pacers.
Runners may not take a vehicle ride that advances their progress; they may rest in a stationary vehicle after checking into an aid station.
Runners who drop must inform the nearest Aid Station Captain, have their ID bracelet cut and return the GPS tracker.
